description: AWS spend from the Cost and Usage Report via Athena: structural cost by component, environment, product, usage type and purchase option.

panels.description: Structural cost over the selected range. Effective cost: Savings Plan and Reserved Instance discounts applied, commitment fees counted only for their unused portion, credits and refunds excluded, RI fees excluded (they book once a month and would distort a running month). Respects the Environment, Component, Product and Usage Type filters.
panels.title: Period Cost

panels.description: Mean of the daily structural cost over the selected range. Multiply by the days in a month for a run rate.
panels.title: Average Daily Cost

panels.description: Most expensive single day in the range; a jump here is where to start reading the breakdowns below.
panels.title: Max Daily Cost

panels.description: Period cost plus the promotional credits and refunds applied in the range: what was actually billed. Credits are account-level lines with no tags, so with a Component or Environment selected this equals Period Cost.
panels.title: Net After Credits

panels.description: Structural cost per UTC day with a trailing 7-day average, and the net after credits as a dashed line. Effective cost: Savings Plan and Reserved Instance discounts applied, commitment fees counted only for their unused portion, credits and refunds excluded, RI fees excluded (they book once a month and would distort a running month). The four tiles above are reductions of this panel's query, so the dashboard runs one Athena query for the overview.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('day', line_item_usage_start_date) AS day,
    sum(CASE WHEN line_item_line_item_type NOT IN ('Credit', 'Refund', 'RIFee') THEN CASE
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'SavingsPlanCoveredUsage' THEN savings_plan_savings_plan_effective_cost
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'SavingsPlanRecurringFee' THEN savings_plan_total_commitment_to_date - savings_plan_used_commitment
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type IN ('SavingsPlanNegation', 'SavingsPlanUpfrontFee') THEN 0
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'DiscountedUsage' THEN reservation_effective_cost
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'RIFee' THEN reservation_unused_amortized_upfront_fee_for_billing_period + reservation_unused_recurring_fee
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'Fee' AND reservation_reservation_a_r_n <> '' THEN 0
      ELSE line_item_unblended_cost
    END ELSE 0 END) AS cost,
    sum(CASE WHEN line_item_line_item_type IN ('Credit', 'Refund') THEN line_item_unblended_cost ELSE 0 END) AS credits
  FROM ${cur_table}
  WHERE DATE(line_item_usage_start_date) BETWEEN date_add('day', -6, DATE($__timeFrom)) AND DATE($__timeTo)
    AND ('__all__' IN (${environment:sqlstring}) OR coalesce(nullif(resource_tags_user_environment, ''), 'untagged') IN (${environment:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all__' IN (${component:sqlstring}) OR CASE
          WHEN resource_tags_user_component <> '' THEN resource_tags_user_component
          WHEN product_product_name = 'Amazon Virtual Private Cloud' THEN 'VPC'
          WHEN line_item_usage_type = 'EBS:SnapshotUsage' THEN 'EBSSnapshots'
          ELSE coalesce(nullif(replace(regexp_replace(product_product_name, '^(Amazon|AWS) ?', ''), ' ', ''), ''), 'Other')
        END IN (${component:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all__' IN (${product:sqlstring}) OR regexp_replace(product_product_name, '^(Amazon|AWS) ?', '') IN (${product:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all__' IN (${usagetype:sqlstring}) OR line_item_usage_type IN (${usagetype:sqlstring}))
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  day,
  cost AS "Cost",
  avg(cost) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "7-day average",
  cost + credits AS "Net after credits"
FROM daily
WHERE day >= DATE($__timeFrom)
ORDER BY day

panels.title: Daily Cost

panels.description: Period total per platform component (the Component tag). Lines without the tag fall back to the AWS product that billed them, so untagged spend is visible rather than dropped. Effective cost: Savings Plan and Reserved Instance discounts applied, commitment fees counted only for their unused portion, credits and refunds excluded, RI fees excluded (they book once a month and would distort a running month).

  CASE
    WHEN resource_tags_user_component <> '' THEN resource_tags_user_component

    ELSE coalesce(nullif(replace(regexp_replace(product_product_name, '^(Amazon|AWS) ?', ''), ' ', ''), ''), 'Other')
  END AS component,
  sum(CASE
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'SavingsPlanCoveredUsage' THEN savings_plan_savings_plan_effective_cost
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'SavingsPlanRecurringFee' THEN savings_plan_total_commitment_to_date - savings_plan_used_commitment
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type IN ('SavingsPlanNegation', 'SavingsPlanUpfrontFee') THEN 0
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'DiscountedUsage' THEN reservation_effective_cost
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'RIFee' THEN reservation_unused_amortized_upfront_fee_for_billing_period + reservation_unused_recurring_fee
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'Fee' AND reservation_reservation_a_r_n <> '' THEN 0
    ELSE line_item_unblended_cost

        WHEN product_product_name = 'Amazon Virtual Private Cloud' THEN 'VPC'
        WHEN line_item_usage_type = 'EBS:SnapshotUsage' THEN 'EBSSnapshots'
        ELSE coalesce(nullif(replace(regexp_replace(product_product_name, '^(Amazon|AWS) ?', ''), ' ', ''), ''), 'Other')

  AND ('__all__' IN (${product:sqlstring}) OR regexp_replace(product_product_name, '^(Amazon|AWS) ?', '') IN (${product:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__all__' IN (${usagetype:sqlstring}) OR line_item_usage_type IN (${usagetype:sqlstring}))

      WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'RIFee' THEN reservation_unused_amortized_upfront_fee_for_billing_period + reservation_unused_recurring_fee
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'Fee' AND reservation_reservation_a_r_n <> '' THEN 0
      ELSE line_item_unblended_cost
    END AS cost
  FROM ${cur_table}
  WHERE DATE(line_item_usage_start_date) BETWEEN DATE($__timeFrom) AND DATE($__timeTo)
    AND line_item_line_item_type NOT IN ('Credit', 'Refund', 'RIFee')
    AND ('__all__' IN (${environment:sqlstring}) OR coalesce(nullif(resource_tags_user_environment, ''), 'untagged') IN (${environment:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all__' IN (${component:sqlstring}) OR CASE
          WHEN resource_tags_user_component <> '' THEN resource_tags_user_component
          WHEN product_product_name = 'Amazon Virtual Private Cloud' THEN 'VPC'
          WHEN line_item_usage_type = 'EBS:SnapshotUsage' THEN 'EBSSnapshots'
          ELSE coalesce(nullif(replace(regexp_replace(product_product_name, '^(Amazon|AWS) ?', ''), ' ', ''), ''), 'Other')
        END IN (${component:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all__' IN (${product:sqlstring}) OR regexp_replace(product_product_name, '^(Amazon|AWS) ?', '') IN (${product:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all__' IN (${usagetype:sqlstring}) OR line_item_usage_type IN (${usagetype:sqlstring}))
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT category, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sum(cost) DESC) AS rn
  FROM lines
  GROUP BY category
)
SELECT
  l.bucket,
  CASE WHEN r.rn <= 30 THEN l.category ELSE 'Other' END AS usage_type,
  sum(l.cost) AS cost
FROM lines l
JOIN ranked r ON r.category = l.category
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, min(CASE WHEN r.rn <= 30 THEN r.rn ELSE 31 END)

Effective cost: Savings Plan and Reserved Instance discounts applied, commitment fees counted only for their unused portion, credits and refunds excluded, RI fees excluded (they book once a month and would distort a running month).

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'DiscountedUsage' THEN 'Reserved Instance'

    WHEN line_item_line_item_type IN ('SavingsPlanNegation', 'SavingsPlanUpfrontFee') THEN 0
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'DiscountedUsage' THEN reservation_effective_cost
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'RIFee' THEN reservation_unused_amortized_upfront_fee_for_billing_period + reservation_unused_recurring_fee
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'Fee' AND reservation_reservation_a_r_n <> '' THEN 0
    ELSE line_item_unblended_cost
  END) AS cost
FROM ${cur_table}
WHERE DATE(line_item_usage_start_date) BETWEEN DATE($__timeFrom) AND DATE($__timeTo)
  AND line_item_line_item_type NOT IN ('Credit', 'Refund', 'RIFee')
  AND ('__all__' IN (${environment:sqlstring}) OR coalesce(nullif(resource_tags_user_environment, ''), 'untagged') IN (${environment:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__all__' IN (${component:sqlstring}) OR CASE
        WHEN resource_tags_user_component <> '' THEN resource_tags_user_component
        WHEN product_product_name = 'Amazon Virtual Private Cloud' THEN 'VPC'
        WHEN line_item_usage_type = 'EBS:SnapshotUsage' THEN 'EBSSnapshots'
        ELSE coalesce(nullif(replace(regexp_replace(product_product_name, '^(Amazon|AWS) ?', ''), ' ', ''), ''), 'Other')
      END IN (${component:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__all__' IN (${product:sqlstring}) OR regexp_replace(product_product_name, '^(Amazon|AWS) ?', '') IN (${product:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__all__' IN (${usagetype:sqlstring}) OR line_item_usage_type IN (${usagetype:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY 1
HAVING sum(CASE
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'SavingsPlanCoveredUsage' THEN savings_plan_savings_plan_effective_cost
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'SavingsPlanRecurringFee' THEN savings_plan_total_commitment_to_date - savings_plan_used_commitment
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type IN ('SavingsPlanNegation', 'SavingsPlanUpfrontFee') THEN 0
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'DiscountedUsage' THEN reservation_effective_cost
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'RIFee' THEN reservation_unused_amortized_upfront_fee_for_billing_period + reservation_unused_recurring_fee
    WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'Fee' AND reservation_reservation_a_r_n <> '' THEN 0
    ELSE line_item_unblended_cost
  END) > 0
ORDER BY cost DESC

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('$granularity', line_item_usage_start_date) AS bucket,
    CASE
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'DiscountedUsage' THEN 'Reserved Instance'
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'SavingsPlanCoveredUsage' THEN 'Savings Plan'
      WHEN line_item_usage_type LIKE '%Spot%' THEN 'Spot'
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage' THEN 'On-Demand'
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type IN ('RIFee', 'SavingsPlanRecurringFee', 'SavingsPlanUpfrontFee') THEN 'Unused Commitment'
      ELSE 'Tax & Fees'
    END AS category,
    CASE
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'SavingsPlanCoveredUsage' THEN savings_plan_savings_plan_effective_cost
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'SavingsPlanRecurringFee' THEN savings_plan_total_commitment_to_date - savings_plan_used_commitment
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type IN ('SavingsPlanNegation', 'SavingsPlanUpfrontFee') THEN 0
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'DiscountedUsage' THEN reservation_effective_cost
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'RIFee' THEN reservation_unused_amortized_upfront_fee_for_billing_period + reservation_unused_recurring_fee
      WHEN line_item_line_item_type = 'Fee' AND reservation_reservation_a_r_n <> '' THEN 0
      ELSE line_item_unblended_cost
    END AS cost
  FROM ${cur_table}
  WHERE DATE(line_item_usage_start_date) BETWEEN DATE($__timeFrom) AND DATE($__timeTo)
    AND line_item_line_item_type NOT IN ('Credit', 'Refund', 'RIFee')
    AND ('__all__' IN (${environment:sqlstring}) OR coalesce(nullif(resource_tags_user_environment, ''), 'untagged') IN (${environment:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all__' IN (${component:sqlstring}) OR CASE
          WHEN resource_tags_user_component <> '' THEN resource_tags_user_component
          WHEN product_product_name = 'Amazon Virtual Private Cloud' THEN 'VPC'
          WHEN line_item_usage_type = 'EBS:SnapshotUsage' THEN 'EBSSnapshots'
          ELSE coalesce(nullif(replace(regexp_replace(product_product_name, '^(Amazon|AWS) ?', ''), ' ', ''), ''), 'Other')
        END IN (${component:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all__' IN (${product:sqlstring}) OR regexp_replace(product_product_name, '^(Amazon|AWS) ?', '') IN (${product:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all__' IN (${usagetype:sqlstring}) OR line_item_usage_type IN (${usagetype:sqlstring}))
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT category, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sum(cost) DESC) AS rn
  FROM lines
  GROUP BY category
)
SELECT
  l.bucket,
  CASE WHEN r.rn <= 10 THEN l.category ELSE 'Other' END AS purchase_option,
  sum(l.cost) AS cost
FROM lines l
JOIN ranked r ON r.category = l.category
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, min(CASE WHEN r.rn <= 10 THEN r.rn ELSE 11 END)
